| fields _time vdevice-name ifname if-oper-status 
| sort 0 vdevice-name ifname _time 
| streamstats current=f last(if-oper-status) as prev_status by vdevice-name ifname 
| where 'if-oper-status' != prev_status 
| stats 
    count as flap_count 
    earliest(_time) as first_flap 
    latest(_time) as last_flap 
    by vdevice-name ifname | where flap_count > 1 
| eval 
    duration_sec = last_flap - first_flap,
    duration = tostring(duration_sec, "duration"),
    flap_rate_min = round(flap_count / (duration_sec / 60), 2),
    last_flap_time = strftime(last_flap, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
    severity = case(
    flap_count > 15 OR flap_rate_min > 2, "🔴 High",
    flap_count > 5, "🟠 Medium",
    1=1, "🟡 Low") 
| sort - flap_count 
| table severity vdevice-name ifname flap_count flap_rate_min last_flap_time duration
description: Extracted from production dashboard: Acme SD-WAN - Operations Command Center

title: Core Network (SRv6): Network Telemetry
spl:
| mstats 
    avg("Cisco-IOS-XR-fib-common-oper:fib/nodes/node/protocols/protocol/vrfs/vrf/summary.routes") AS avg_current_routes 
    WHERE index="cisco_metrics" earliest=-2d@d latest=now span=15m 
    BY source,vrf_name,node_name,protocol_name 
| search source="$source$" node_name="$node_name$"
| eval vrf_name=replace(vrf_name, "\\*+", "iid")
| search vrf_name="$vrf_name$"
| eval time_of_day=strftime(_time, "%H")
| eventstats avg(avg_current_routes) AS mean stdev(avg_current_routes) AS stdev BY time_of_day,source,vrf_name,node_name,protocol_name
| eval z_score = abs((avg_current_routes - mean) / stdev)
| eval is_anomaly = if(z_score > 1.5 AND isnotnull(z_score), 1, 0)
| eval anomaly = if(is_anomaly == 1, "Yes", "No")
| eval anomaly_score = if(isnotnull(z_score), round(1 / (1 + z_score), 3), 0)
| search _time>=$global_time.earliest$ _time<=$global_time.latest$
| fields _time, source, vrf_name, node_name, protocol_name, avg_current_routes, anomaly
| eventstats values(source) AS all_sources BY vrf_name
| eval all_sources_size=mvcount(all_sources)
| eval source=source
| eval target=if(all_sources_size > 1, mvindex(all_sources, if(mvfind(all_sources, source) + 1 >= all_sources_size, 0, mvfind(all_sources, source) + 1)), null())
| where source != target
| eval value=coalesce(round(avg_current_routes, 0), 0)
| eval link_label=vrf_name . " (" . value . " routes)"
| eval tooltip="VRF: " . vrf_name . ", Routes: " . value . ", Anomaly: " . anomaly
| eval link_color=upper(case(value < 50, "#00FF00", value >= 50 AND value <= 75, "#FFFF00", value > 75, "#FF0000", true(), "#808080"))
| fields source, target, value, link_label, tooltip, link_color

``` --- Filter by router selected in dropdown ---```
| search source="$tok_source$"

``` --- Build total error rate ---```
| eval total_error_rate = input_error_rate + output_error_rate
| where total_error_rate > 1

``` --- Apply trained DensityFunction model ---```
| apply app:iface_err_df_model_v2

``` --- Outlier flag from model ---```
| eval is_outlier = 'IsOutlier(total_error_rate)'
| where is_outlier=1

``` --- Normalize BoundaryRanges text for parsing ---```
| eval BoundaryRangesClean = replace(BoundaryRanges, "\r", "")
| eval br = split(BoundaryRangesClean, "\n")
| eval br = mvmap(br, trim(br))

``` --- Identify high / low boundary lines if present ---```
| eval high_line = mvindex(mvfilter(match(br, ":Infinity:")), 0)
| eval low_line  = mvindex(mvfilter(match(br, "^-Infinity:")), 0)

``` --- Extract numeric threshold values and probabilities ---```
| rex field=high_line "^(?<high_threshold_raw>[^:]+):Infinity:(?<high_p>[\d\.]+)"
| rex field=low_line  "^-Infinity:(?<low_threshold_raw>[^:]+):(?<low_p>[\d\.]+)"

| eval high_threshold = tonumber(high_threshold_raw)
| eval low_threshold  = tonumber(low_threshold_raw)

``` --- Determine anomaly direction ---```
| eval direction = case(
    isnotnull(high_threshold) AND total_error_rate >= high_threshold, "HIGH spike",
    isnotnull(low_threshold)  AND total_error_rate <= low_threshold,  "LOW dip",
    true(), "DENSITY outlier"
)

``` --- Prepare readable boundary string ---```
| eval ranges_one_line = if(len(BoundaryRangesClean)>0, replace(BoundaryRangesClean,"\n"," | "), null())

``` --- Human-readable explanation ---```
| eval why = case(
    direction="HIGH spike",
      "Outlier per model: value " . round(total_error_rate,2) . " > " . round(coalesce(high_threshold,0),2)

      "Outlier per model: value " . round(total_error_rate,2) . " < " . round(coalesce(low_threshold,0),2)
      . " (rare-low p=" . coalesce(low_p,"n/a") . ")",

    true(),
      "Outlier per model (density-based): value " . round(total_error_rate,2)
      . " is statistically rare for this router. Boundaries: "
      . coalesce(ranges_one_line,"not provided by model")
)

``` --- Operator guidance ---```

    direction="HIGH spike",
      "Check interface counters on " . source . " for packet drops or CRC errors. Verify optics, cabling, and recent config changes.",

    direction="LOW dip",
      "Verify interface operational status on " . source . ". Possible link flap or traffic interruption. Check syslog and routing adjacencies.",

    true(),
      "Investigate abnormal interface error behavior on " . source . ". Review interface statistics, recent changes, and correlated network events."
)

title: BGP Flap Detection - Connection Drops
spl:
| mstats 
    latest("openconfig:network-instances/network-instance/protocols/protocol/bgp/neighbors/neighbor/state.Cisco_IOS_XR_openconfig_bgp_ext:cisco/connection_down_count") AS connection_drops 
    latest("openconfig:network-instances/network-instance/protocols/protocol/bgp/neighbors/neighbor/state.established_transitions") AS est_transitions 
    latest("openconfig:network-instances/network-instance/protocols/protocol/bgp/neighbors/neighbor/state.messages/received/NOTIFICATION") AS notifications_received 
    latest("openconfig:network-instances/network-instance/protocols/protocol/bgp/neighbors/neighbor/state.messages/sent/NOTIFICATION") AS notifications_sent 
    WHERE index="cisco_metrics" span=5m BY source, neighbor_address | search source=$networksrc$ neighbor_address=$neighbour$
| sort 0 source, neighbor_address, _time
| streamstats current=f last(connection_drops) as prev_connection_drops last(est_transitions) as prev_est_transitions last(notifications_received) as prev_notifications_received last(notifications_sent) as prev_notifications_sent by source, neighbor_address
| eval delta_connection_drops = connection_drops - coalesce(prev_connection_drops, 0)
| eval delta_est_transitions = est_transitions - coalesce(prev_est_transitions, 0)
| eval delta_notifications_received = notifications_received - coalesce(prev_notifications_received, 0)
| eval delta_notifications_sent = notifications_sent - coalesce(prev_notifications_sent, 0)
| eval flap_score = delta_connection_drops + delta_est_transitions + delta_notifications_received + delta_notifications_sent
| where flap_score > 0
| eval target = neighbor_address
| stats max(flap_score) AS flap_score, max(delta_connection_drops) AS delta_connection_drops BY source, target, _time

title: Firewall FTD
spl:
index=* sourcetype=cisco:sfw:estreamer 
| eval act=coalesce(AC_RuleAction, action)
| timechart span=5m
    count(eval(act="Allow" OR act="allowed")) as allowed
    count(eval(act="Block"  OR act="denied"))  as denied
    sum(coalesce(bytes,ResponderBytes,InitiatorBytes,0)) as bytes_total
| eventstats perc5(bytes_total)  AS p5
            perc50(bytes_total) AS p50
            perc90(bytes_total) AS p90
| eval deny_rate = if(allowed+denied>0, round(100*denied/(allowed+denied),2), 0)

| eval throughput_score = case(
      bytes_total>=p90, 100,
      bytes_total>=p50, 85,
      bytes_total>=p5,  70,
      true(),           50
)

| eval block_score = case(
      deny_rate<=2,  100,
      deny_rate<=5,   85,
      deny_rate<=10,  70,
      true(),         50
)
| eval fw_kpi_raw = 0.6*throughput_score + 0.4*block_score
| eval fw_kpi     = round( max(1, min(100, fw_kpi_raw)), 0 )
| timechart span=5m avg(fw_kpi) AS fw_kpi

| eval l3_maj          = if(component="l3extOut" AND sev="major",1,0)
| eval l3_min          = if(component="l3extOut" AND sev="minor",1,0)
| eval l3_warn         = if(component="l3extOut" AND sev="warning",1,0)

| eval leaf_cur        = if(component="fabricNode" AND Role="leaf"  AND like(dn,"topology/%"), cur, null())
| eval spine_cur       = if(component="fabricNode" AND Role="spine" AND like(dn,"topology/%"), cur, null())
| stats
    latest(k_fabric) as k_fabric
    avg(k_tenant_cur) as k_tenant_cur
    sum(t_crit) as t_crit
    sum(t_maj)  as t_maj
    sum(t_min)  as t_min
    sum(t_warn) as t_warn
    avg(k_bd_cur)  as k_bd_cur
    avg(k_epg_cur) as k_epg_cur
    sum(l3_crit) as l3_crit
    sum(l3_maj)  as l3_maj
    sum(l3_min)  as l3_min
    sum(l3_warn) as l3_warn
    avg(leaf_cur)  as leaf_cur
    avg(spine_cur) as spine_cur
  by _time apic_host TenantName
| eval kpi0_fabric = round(coalesce(k_fabric,100))
| eval kpi0_fabric = case(kpi0_fabric>=99,100, kpi0_fabric<=80,80, true(), kpi0_fabric)
| eval kpi1_tenant_calc = 100 - (coalesce(t_crit,0)*50 + coalesce(t_maj,0)*30 + coalesce(t_min,0)*15 + coalesce(t_warn,0)*5)
| eval kpi1_tenant = max(0, coalesce(round(k_tenant_cur), kpi1_tenant_calc, 100))
| eval kpi2_bd   = round(coalesce(k_bd_cur,  100))
| eval kpi3_epg  = round(coalesce(k_epg_cur, 100))
| eval kpi4_l3   = max(0, 100 - (coalesce(l3_crit,0)*50 + coalesce(l3_maj,0)*30 + coalesce(l3_min,0)*15 + coalesce(l3_warn,0)*5))
| eval kpi5_leaf  = round(coalesce(leaf_cur,  100))
| eval kpi6_spine = round(coalesce(spine_cur, 100))
| eval aci_health = round(
      0.10*kpi0_fabric
    + 0.20*kpi1_tenant
    + 0.20*kpi2_bd
    + 0.15*kpi3_epg
    + 0.15*kpi4_l3
    + 0.10*kpi5_leaf
    + 0.10*kpi6_spine
,0) | timechart span=1m avg(aci_health) as aci_health_kpi | where isnotnull(aci_health_kpi)

title: Service Alerts
spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` avg(Test_Metrics.metric_name:http.server.request.availability) AS avg_avail
  FROM datamodel="Cisco_ThousandEyes.Test_Metrics"
  WHERE Test_Metrics.thousandeyes.account.id="*******"
        Test_Metrics.thousandeyes.test.type="http-server"
        Test_Metrics.metric_name:http.server.request.availability=*
  BY _time span=1m
| where isnotnull(avg_avail) AND round(avg_avail,2)=0
| eval alert_message = "🔴 ALERT (ThousandEyes): Acme web service is unavailable and service impacting. Current Availability: " . tostring(avg_avail) . "%"
| eval alert_source = "ThousandEyes"
| fields _time, alert_source, alert_message
| append
    [
    | mstats max("Cisco-IOS-XR-ipv4-bgp-oper:bgp/instances/instance/instance-active/vrfs/vrf/afs/af/neighbor-af-table/neighbor.af_data/prefixes_accepted") AS prefixes_accepted
        WHERE index="cisco_metrics" AND af_name="ipv4-unicast" span=1m
        BY neighbor_address, source
    | search neighbor_address=10.30.4.137
    | eval kpi1_prefixes_health = if(prefixes_accepted >= 4, 100, 0)
    | where kpi1_prefixes_health = 0
    | eval alert_message = "⚠️ ALERT (BGP/Network): WebService lost network connectivity to upstream router " . neighbor_address . ". Subnet 10.30.104.0/24 for Maple is not advertised anymore. Prefixes Accepted: " . tostring(prefixes_accepted)
    | eval alert_source = "BGP"
    | fields _time, alert_source, alert_message
    ]
| stats count AS alert_count, min(_time) AS first_occurrence_epoch, max(_time) AS last_occurrence_epoch BY alert_source, alert_message
| eval first_occurrence = strftime(first_occurrence_epoch, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
| eval last_occurrence = strftime(last_occurrence_epoch, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
| eval is_actual_alert = 1
| fields alert_source, alert_message, alert_count, first_occurrence, last_occurrence, is_actual_alert
| union
    [
    | makeresults count=1
    | eval alert_message="✅ No Service Alerts"
    | eval alert_source=null(), alert_count=null(), first_occurrence=null(), last_occurrence=null()
    | eval is_actual_alert = 0
    | fields alert_source, alert_message, alert_count, first_occurrence, last_occurrence, is_actual_alert
    ]
| eventstats sum(is_actual_alert) AS total_actual_alerts
| where is_actual_alert=1 OR total_actual_alerts=0
| table alert_source, alert_message, alert_count, first_occurrence, last_occurrence
